learning.title: A JSX space between an inline-flex link's text and its icon renders as nothing; the gap belongs on the variant
learning.trigger: An arrow or icon inside an inline-flex link sits flush against its text, or a spacing attempt between the text and the icon has no visible effect in the browser or in a visual capture.
learning.mistake: Left a whitespace expression between the text and the icon and expected it to render, then chased the missing space as a font, token or padding problem.
learning.rule: An inline-flex container collapses the whitespace-only text nodes between its children, so a JSX space between an inline-flex link's text and its icon is dead on arrival. Express the space in CSS: put gap on the link variant that owns the icon instead of a per-instance wrapper. The shared variant is the place to look first, because one fix there clears every call site — the same variant fix cleared four pre-existing IssuePage arrows, so when one icon spacing looks wrong, check the variant before touching the call site.

verification.requirement: Confirm the space comes from a gap on the variant, then prove it with the story check and a visual capture at the head SHA.
